svg.title: Figure 4. Generalisation by task group and evidence regime
svg.desc: Heatmap of 9 arms by 11 columns; values in figures/final/fig4_generalisation.csv
svg.text: Figure 4. Where each policy holds up: task groups and evidence regimes on txn_test
Each cell pools the arm's seeds. Left block: verified completion. Right block: safe terminal outcome (verified, or a correct hand-off with no harm).

svg.text: Source: results/txn/*__txn_test.summary.json and results/sel1/*__txn_test.summary.json (blocks by_group, by_regime). Cells: episodes; models run each task once greedily and twice sampled per seed. The
quadruples include the unresolvable regime, where completion is not the safe outcome, so their VTC is capped by design for an agent that hands off. Warm-start rows are SFT only; RL rows add GRPO on
top of the Dw warm start; SEL1 rows continue Dw_aug with SFT. Single-seed rows: base, W, Dw. No intervals are drawn; see fig4 CSV for per-seed rates.
